experiments.description: Theoretical end-to-end quantum Monte Carlo pricing for path-dependent derivatives over a fast-forwardable Cox–Ingersoll–Ross (CIR) process, including discrete-sum loading and discretization analysis.

algorithm.variant: Quantum Monte Carlo integration with fast-forwarded CIR state preparation

hyperparameters.r: degrees of freedom parameter for chi-square primitive
hyperparameters.eta: CIR parameter eta = 4 theta kappa / sigma^2

problem_formulation.objective_function: Estimate E[f(V)] for a CIR path process V(t) with piecewise-linear payoff f
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Truncation of Gaussian and chi-square primitives; left-endpoint Riemann discretization; coherent arithmetic for recursive CIR update

problem_instance.description: CIR path process with recursive fast-forwarding scheme and piecewise-linear payoff over T monitoring points

dataset_specification.description: No empirical dataset; theoretical CIR model with parameters v0, kappa, theta, sigma, delta

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Truncate standard Gaussian to [-a,a] and chi-square to [bL,bU]; discretize with N grid points; recursively compute CIR transitions
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Amplitude estimation on the encoded discrete sum
